votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 11 of 2025 approving an amendment to the 2006 Sunrise Metro Acquisition Loan to forgive accrued interest to facilitate the preservation and redevelopment of permanent supportive housing.
votes.description: Amends the terms of a 2006 loan for the Sunrise Metro project to forgive accrued interest, enabling the preservation and redevelopment of permanent supportive housing.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for the purposes of strategy sessions to discuss the purchase, exchange, or lease of real property, and advice of counsel.
votes.description: Authorizes the Board to convene a closed session to discuss real property transactions and receive attorney-client privileged legal advice.
Formally concludes the closed session and returns the Board to open meeting.
